purpose: First safe source-target selection artifact for the daily public-source ingestion pipeline. This dry run records the target selection format and safety gates without making provider calls.
selectionRules: Prefer official public sources and existing Notary Geek public source indexes.
Choose high-value source records before shallow fifty-state breadth.
Require source class, publisher, jurisdiction or topic, retrieval target, and route relevance before collection.
Exclude customer facts, private operating context, secrets, raw credentials, provider dashboards, payment data, identity data, and raw prompts.
